name: ai-usage-watch
description: Monitor AI subscription usage from the terminal

scripts.start:opencode-go: npm run build && node dist/index.js --provider opencode-go
scripts.start:claude-ai: npm run build && node dist/index.js --provider claude-ai
scripts.start:all: npm run build && node -e "const { spawn } = require('node:child_process'); const run = (args) => new Promise(r => spawn('node', args, { stdio: 'inherit' }).on('close', r)); Promise.all([run(['dist/index.js', '--provider', 'opencode-go']), run(['dist/index.js', '--provider', 'claude-ai'])]);"
